study type: Secondary data analysis of two national cross-sectional studies
exposure: Hospital management authority (public, private for-profit, private not-for-profit)
cohort: 111 hospitals in 2008 and 316 hospitals in 2016, and 275 women whose CD chart was reviewed in 2008 and 568 in 2016 in Ethiopia
finding: Between 2008 and 2016 in Ethiopia, government efforts increased CD service availability, improved public hospital readiness for CD, and improved some aspects of clinical quality, but further strategies are needed to address high unmet need for CD and potentially unnecessary cesareans.
